entry.summary:
The way we listen to the consumer and their whānau, and demonstrate manaakitanga (kindness, respect and support) shapes everyone’s understanding of the issues to inform diagnosis.  

Carlton Irving, Director Māori Health and Consumer at Te Tāhū Hauora Health Quality & Safety Commission, discusses the importance of manaakitanga in diagnosis.

For more information on Aotearoa Patient Safety Day, visit hqsc.govt.nz/AotearoaPatientSafetyDay2024
